purpose: Preserve D3 v1 manual-review boundaries while promoting exactly one verified cross-domain localization owner: the frozen Localization Audit Stage 5 snapshot gate. D3 v2 remains plan-only.

statusPolicy.PLAN_READY: All changed paths are mapped and every impacted node that requires a dedicated check is either covered by a verified catalog entry or does not require a dedicated validator in D3.
statusPolicy.MANUAL_REVIEW: At least one changed path is unmapped or at least one impacted node has no verified dedicated check in the D3 catalog.
statusPolicy.NO_CHANGES: The selected source mode produced no changed paths.
statusPolicy.INVALID_INPUT: Source mode arguments, git refs, stdin, or repository paths are invalid.

checkCatalog.coverage: Checks current parsed ConfigData source integrity only; it does not by itself prove downstream frozen semantic parity.
Runs the frozen Localization Audit Stage 5 snapshot gate. It owns localization identity/display/frontend-boundary validation only and does not clear canonical/relation/asset MANUAL_REVIEW nodes.
Production build/type/route generation surface. It is not a substitute for hosted/browser QA or asset provenance validation.

manualReviewNodes.hero-canonical: No final frozen Hero semantic validator command is promoted into the verified D3 catalog. Keep the frozen Hero boundary closed until an owning-stage validator is explicitly cataloged.
manualReviewNodes.soldier-canonical: No final frozen Soldier semantic validator command is promoted into the verified D3 catalog.
manualReviewNodes.equipment-canonical: No final frozen Equipment semantic validator command is promoted into the verified D3 catalog.
manualReviewNodes.hero-soldier-relation: The 5,977-edge shared relation requires its owning frozen relation validator; D3 does not invent or substitute a command.
manualReviewNodes.hero-equipment-relation: Exclusive Equipment ownership requires its owning frozen relation validator; D3 does not invent or substitute a command.
manualReviewNodes.banner-data: Banner frozen consumer changes require an explicitly cataloged Banner regression validator; production build alone is not semantic proof.
manualReviewNodes.skin-relation: Skin ownership/order changes require the owning frozen relation validator.
manualReviewNodes.hero-assets: Hero asset changes need an asset-specific provenance/resolution check in addition to build; no verified command is cataloged yet.
manualReviewNodes.soldier-assets: Soldier portrait/source derivative changes need an asset-specific manifest/provenance check in addition to build; no verified command is cataloged yet.
manualReviewNodes.equipment-assets: Equipment asset-pipeline changes need an asset-specific locator/resolution check; no verified command is cataloged yet.
manualReviewNodes.banner-assets: Banner asset changes need the Banner asset relation/regression check in addition to build; no verified command is cataloged yet.
manualReviewNodes.skin-assets: Skin Stage 3 asset evidence/resolution requires its owning asset validator; no verified command is cataloged yet.
manualReviewNodes.shared-movement: Shared movement/stat source changes need the owning shared-data validator in addition to build; no verified command is cataloged yet.

nextStageGoal: Execute the selected localization audit through the strict D4 allowlist before production build, while preserving fail-fast and manual-review behavior.
